checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law or accessory apartment provision
In R-1 no existing single family dwelling may be converted into two or more dwelling units (702.15)
Two-family dwellings are allowed by right in R-2 and R-3 (Section 501). A second unit inside or added to the house is possible as a two-family dwelling, not as an ADU
Two-family lots in R-2 and R-3 need 3,500 sq ft per dwelling unit (7,000 sq ft for two) and 75 ft of width (Section 508). Single family needs 5,000 sq ft
Section 501 lists 'Accessory Residential Uses' as permitted in R-1, R-2 and R-3. Article 2 does not define it. Ask the zoning office whether it covers anything beyond garages and sheds
Permitted residential accessory structures are greenhouses, sheds, private garages or carports, pools and satellite dishes (Section 305). A dwelling is not on the list
More than one principal structure on a lot needs land development approval (314.1)
A rented unit needs registration, a rental inspection report and an occupancy license (Chapter 7, Article VII, 7-218 to 7-226)
A dwelling unit is for one family. More than four unrelated persons is not a family (Section 203)

status.note: The code has no ADU text. R-1 bars converting a single family dwelling into two or more units (702.15). Two-family dwellings are by right in R-2 and R-3, which is the nearest path.

path.note: 'No existing single family dwelling unit shall be converted into two or more dwelling units ... in an R-1' district. Two-family is not listed in R-1 (501). The path is a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. Section 324 (unlisted uses by special exception) is a weak argument here, because 501 lists dwelling types and 702.15 denies the R-1 conversion.

value.note: Not an ADU. 'Two Family Dwellings' are X (by right) in R-2 and R-3. A second unit in or added to the house is possible as a two-family dwelling on a lot with 3,500 sq ft per unit (7,000 total) and 75 ft width.

district_paths.note: Two-family dwelling by right in R-2 and R-3.

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. A second unit as a two-family dwelling: by right in R-2 and R-3 only.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path. 703 adds HD Historic Overlay rules.

value.condition: R-1: 'No existing single family dwelling unit shall be converted into two or more dwelling units.'
Two-family dwelling: lot width 75 ft and 3,500 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit (Section 508).
A detached second dwelling is not a listed residential accessory structure (305), and a second principal structure needs land development approval (314.1).
A rented unit needs registration, a rental inspection report and an occupancy license from the code enforcement officer.

types_allowed.note: Not an ADU form. In R-2 and R-3 a second unit inside or added to the house as a two-family dwelling. Barred in R-1 (702.15).

max_height_ft.note: Unattached accessory structures in R zones: 'one and one-half (1 1/2) stories or fifteen (15) feet, whichever is the lesser.'

setback_front_ft.note: Unattached accessory structures in any R zone 'shall be erected only within the rear or side yard'. Not in the front yard.

setback_side_ft.note: 'not less than five (5) feet from either side lot line'. Corner lots follow Section 304.

setback_rear_ft.note: 'not less than five (5) feet from the rear lot line'.

setback_rear_alley_ft.note: 'when the accessory structure abuts an alley, ten (10) feet shall be required.'

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on the same lot found in Section 302.

max_building_coverage.note: Varies by district: R-1 40%, R-2 50%, R-3 60%. See districts.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A dwelling unit is for one family. A group over four unrelated persons is not a family.

max_adus.note: No ADU. A two-family dwelling holds two units in R-2 and R-3. None added in R-1.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. Single-family detached and two-family: 'Two (2) spaces for each dwelling unit.'

total_on_site.note: Two-family structure: 'Two (2) spaces for each dwelling unit.' 4 in total for the two units in R-2 or R-3.
